infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sara needs access to your microphone for voice chat.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Sara needs access to speech recognition for voice chat.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sara needs access to your photo library to send images in chat.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sara needs camera access to take photos for chat.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Sara reads your health data to provide personalized wellness insights, track your fitness progress, and help you achieve your health goals.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Sara can write workout and nutrition data to Apple Health to keep your health records complete.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Sara reads your calendar to show upcoming events and help you stay organized.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sara uses your location to know where you are and give location-aware answers.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Sara uses your location in the background to notice when you arrive at or leave places, so she can trigger location-based reminders like "remind me to stop by the store when I leave here."
